items.text:
I really want to like this game, and mechanically it seems quite fun. 

However that all gets thrown out the game when it just decides to end your save.

to summarize my experience, i read through all of the manual except the parts about the nuclear reactor, (while doing that i tab out reply to some discord messages, have to go replace some fire alarm batteries.) go into a game, follow the tutorial get to my first ship i dock to it. i literally docked to a front half of a docking clamp, to a wreckage thats like 20 wall tiles, 15 floor tiles, some scrap and a corpse. 

i then get pulled over by the police for illegal salvaging, something i didn't even actually realize was illegal until i see the message from them pulling me over. ( i think the manuel mentions it, but its like 8 pages of technical stuff when you just want to get into playing a game so it doesn't exactly all stick) i get fined 15,000 ( i started with 98.0) i have no idea why i got pulled over and how to stop that, maybe i wasn't supposed to stay that long at the site, maybe you are supposed to turn off your transponder who knows. game or manual doesn't mention anything. 

i eventually go back to the starting station, after mildly looting a 2nd wreckage that seemed to have a very bugged out procedural generation. trying to only take what i can quickly grab with my transponder off to hopefully not get found by the police again. at this point i'm down to 30% rcs fuel so i head back to the station i spawned at to sell all the scrap and N2 canister i yoinked, plus some pda's i grabbed. turned in a dead pirates bounty i found in the 2nd ship. all in all, made about 2k ish. i pay off all my station fees hoping i can ignore the police fine for awhile, (basically cost all my money to pay for docking) get told i can't leave without paying the 15k. i go to the station authority to see if i can get an extension or something. ( a dude who earlier called me on the station speakers, and asked me to plant a bug on some other dude, AND DIDN'T PAY ME OR ANYTHING FOR IT.) dude says no when i request to pay it next time. 

so the save is basically bricked. i can't leave the station until i earn over 7 times what i earned in my entire time in the game over 3 hours. the only way i could maybe get out of this i found was to do kiosk jobs to local deliveries. but the kisok jobs actively suck. if you try to take one, it doesn't let you unless you are at the specific one thats the pick up point, but by the time you move from the one you checked to the pick up point the job has despawned. thus its actually impossible without very lucky rng to even pick up one of the jobs. all while the station fines you for being docked by the hour. and it seems you have to pay to pick up the jobs. 

can't even refund cause it took me 3 hours to go through all this. 

but yeah. TL;DR game has some fun mechanics, but your save can get completely bricked by something it doesn't even really tell you is a thing, and then theres nothing you can do to recover. when all you did was LITERALLY LISTEN TO THE TUTORIAL. if they let salvaging without a license be legal then it'd be a really fun game. (which by the way is 5k a day. again literally 2.5 times more than i made in 3 hours of playing, and if i recall almost a full in game day.)
items.text_zh:
我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，而且从机制上看它似乎相当有趣。

然而，当它突然决定终结你的存档时，这一切都被抛到了九霄云外。

总结一下我的经历：我读完了整本手册，除了关于核反应堆的部分，（读的时候我切出去回复了一些Discord消息，还得去换一些火灾报警器的电池。）进入游戏，跟着教程走，到达了我的第一艘船，我停靠了上去。我实际上停靠到了一个对接夹的前半部分，连着一堆大约20块墙砖、15块地砖、一些废料和一具尸体的残骸。

然后我因为非法打捞被警察拦下了，直到我看到他们拦停我的消息之前，我甚至都没意识到这是违法的。（我想手册里提到过，但那大概是8页的技术性内容，而你只是想赶紧开始玩游戏，所以它并不完全能让人记住。）我被罚款15,000（我一开始只有98.0）。我完全不知道自己为什么被拦下，也不知道怎么避免这种情况，也许我不该在那个地点停留那么久，也许你应该关掉你的应答器，谁知道呢。游戏或手册都没有提到任何相关内容。

i最终回到了起始空间站，在那之前我稍微洗劫了第二个残骸，那个残骸的程序生成似乎有严重的bug。我尽量只拿那些能快速抓取的东西，同时关掉应答器，希望能不再被警察发现。此时我的RCS燃料只剩下30%，所以我回到了我出生的空间站，卖掉了我顺来的所有废料和N2罐，还有我拿的一些PDA。上交了我在第二艘船上找到的一个死海盗的赏金。总而言之，赚了大约2千左右。我付清了所有空间站费用，希望可以暂时无视警察的罚款，（基本上花光了我所有的钱来支付停靠费）结果被告知不付那15k就不能离开。我去找空间站管理局，看看能不能延期什么的。（就是之前通过空间站扬声器呼叫我，让我去给另一个人装窃听器，而且没付我钱也没给任何报酬的那个人。）当我请求下次再付时，那家伙说不行。

所以这个存档基本上算是废了。在赚到超过我整个游戏3小时里所赚的7倍之前，我无法离开空间站。我发现的唯一可能摆脱困境的方法是做自助终端的工作，比如本地送货。但自助终端的工作烂透了。如果你想接一个，除非你正好在特定的取货点，否则它不让你接，但等你从你查看的那个终端移动到取货点时，工作已经消失了。因此，除非运气极好，否则根本不可能接到任何一个工作。与此同时，空间站还按小时对你停靠收费。而且看起来你还得付钱才能接这些工作。

甚至没法退款，因为我花了3个小时才经历完这一切。

但没错。TL;DR 游戏有一些有趣的机制，但你的存档可能会被一些它甚至没有真正告诉过你存在的东西彻底搞废，然后你对此无能为力。而你所做的只是字面意义上地听从了教程。如果他们让无证打捞合法化，那它会是一款非常有趣的游戏。（顺便说一下，许可证是每天5千。再次强调，这字面意义上是我玩3个小时所赚的2.5倍多，如果我没记错的话，差不多是整整一个游戏日。）
